title: SG-6 · Add contribution UI and admin console
summary: Players suggest ideas through a sheet and see the Round countdown; admins operate Rounds behind a token entry
description: Context: the game frontend in game/frontend has a playable 80/20 App but no API client, contribution UI, countdown or admin routes. The backend already serves POST /api/v1/player/session, POST /api/v1/contributions, GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions, GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current and the Bearer-protected /api/v1/admin/* round and execution routes. Desired behavior: a Suggest What Happens Next sheet, a Round countdown and badge, and a token-gated admin console with lifecycle stepper and approve/retry controls. Expected result: all of it works against the existing API with Vitest tests using mocked fetch. Why: players feed the story and the admin runs the cycle without a terminal.
acceptance_criteria: Given the playing view, when the player opens the sheet and submits a prompt, then POST /api/v1/contributions is called and the entry appears in history
Given a current Round, then the countdown shows time left and a status badge with the Round status
Given no admin token entered, then admin routes render only the token form and make no admin request
Given an admin Round, then the stepper marks the current stage among OPEN to COMPLETED
Given a FAILED execution or AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Retry or Approve is clicked, then the matching admin endpoint is called with the Bearer token

in_scope: game/frontend React components, API client and Vitest tests
out_of_scope: New backend endpoints such as reject, logs or test results
preserve: Existing App intro gate, GameLayout, StoryPanel behavior and tests
Only the typed admin token is used as a secret

technical_constraints: Frontend lives in game/frontend (no top-level frontend/ exists)
fetch only, no secrets in env or bundle
definition_of_done: All five requirements delivered with passing unit tests
npm test and tsc --noEmit pass in game/frontend
non_functional: Accessible roles and labels on controls
